content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Chandler

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of experience. Review PMI's formal eligibility criteria now to confirm you meet the education and hours requirement before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend all sessions synchronously with active certified practitioners. This PMI-required coursework prepares you for the exam while fitting the schedules of Chandler's working professionals in semiconductor, IT, and electronics sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing bootcamp coursework, create your PMI account and submit your application detailing your project-management experience. Include your Granite PM Academy course completion certificate. Pay the PMI exam fee once your application is approved.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to solidify your readiness. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Granite PM Academy instructors remain available to answer final questions before your test date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over the standard three-year renewal cycle by attending training, conferences, or publishing work related to project management. Renew your certification with PMI by the deadline to keep your PMP active and competitive in your local market.
